# `try_sum`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the sum calculated from values of a group and the result is null on overflow.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
try_sum(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- try_sum, example 1
> SELECT try_sum(col) FROM VALUES (5), (10), (15) AS tab(col);
30
```

```sql
-- try_sum, example 2
> SELECT try_sum(col) FROM VALUES (NULL), (10), (15) AS tab(col);
25
```

```sql
-- try_sum, example 3
> SELECT try_sum(col) FROM VALUES (NULL), (NULL) AS tab(col);
NULL
```

```sql
-- try_sum, example 4
> SELECT try_sum(col) FROM VALUES (9223372036854775807L), (1L) AS tab(col);
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.3.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
